methodology: Read project AGENTS.md, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/architecture.md, and tests/README.md before review; consulted the requested fragment-grading qualification.

Read all original-suite accepted run 2 responses and every frozen named expectation. Independently considered task selection, meaning, minimal corrections, formatting, complete truthful Changes, source isolation, pronouns, supported draft facts, and shortening levels.
Did not read other runs, prior response records or judgment files, or other chats; did not call a model, spawn agents, use the network, or edit repository evidence.

Read the shipped helper and confirmed its hash matches the frozen resource. Independently ran its direct local CLI with inert JSON datafiles for all four source/candidate shortening comparisons. No historical embedded code was executed.
Graded task as a separate assertion in every case. Mechanical gate acceptance was provided by the controller and was not substituted for semantic judgments.

limitations: These are known synthetic regressions, not a holdout or an estimate of broad reliability.
This review does not establish installed/native host acceptance, actual native rendering or clipboard behavior, or a fresh external Markdown renderer observation.
Visible source-isolation judgments concern the captured behavior; this review does not independently audit hidden reasoning or the controller's complete event/permission boundary.
review_process_notes: An attempted inline Python datafile writer was blocked by the configured supply-chain guard before execution. No capture or evidence was changed. Inert measurement JSON files were instead added directly, followed by the reviewed helper's direct local CLI.
